claim: In internal-transfer-export.pure.ts, the originalTransHisId filter only matches the top-level originalTransHisId field and never checks info.refundFor.
In trans-his-pg.query.ts, JSON_STRING_PATHS is the whitelist of payload JSONB string paths and currently does not contain info.refundFor or info.dstBankAccount.bankAccount.
In trans-his-pg.query.ts, compileFilter supports $or, $and and $expr keys at any conjunction level and refuses any other key that starts with $.
In internal-transfer-export.pure.ts, transformRow exports the sender account as info.dstBankAccount.bankAccount first, then sender.bankAccount.

In models/trans-his-pg/trans-his-pg.query.ts, TEXT_COLUMNS maps 'serviceCode', 'channelId', 'sender.customerId', 'receiver.customerId', 'sender.phone', 'receiver.phone', and 'info.partnerCode' to their corresponding core.* columns.
In internal-transfer-export.pure.ts, buildFilter filters partnerCode using a case-insensitive $regex on info.bankTransferResponse.partnerCode.
In core-trans-proxy-history-service/logics/transHis.manage.logic.ts, getList filters partnerCode using a case-insensitive $regex on info.bankTransferResponse.partnerCode.
